title: Galaxy for accessible; reproducible; and collaborative data analyses: 2026 update.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context: the data availability statement only says 'Galaxy is freely available at https://galaxyproject.org'. Queried the Zenodo API for the only accession in the text (10.5281/zenodo.19833847): it is galaxy-mcp v1.11.0, a 1.7 MB source-code zip, not a dataset. Supplement listing timed out (Europe PMC flags say no supplement).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Usage figures (650,000 registered users, ~2,000,000 monthly jobs) and the feature list come from the abstract only.

a1_downloadable.note: No biological dataset is released; the only deposit (checked via Zenodo API) is software source code for a Galaxy MCP (model context protocol) server.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table and no measured outcome exists; any label would have to be invented, e.g. from Galaxy job logs that the paper does not release.

a3_inputs_present.note: No inputs; this paper describes a software platform update.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Trivially small, but it is code, not data.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No dataset to compare against the paper.

honest_claim_h3: None possible: the paper is a software platform update and releases no labelled biological data.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use records of past analysis runs on a public analysis platform to predict whether a job fails or how long it takes.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need per-job records (tool, input size, parameters); none are released with this paper, so the count is unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Job success or run time, which would come from server logs that are not part of this paper's deposits.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Server operators could schedule jobs better, but this is not a biology question, and the data isn't available here anyway.

label_elsewhere.sources: None identified; not searched since Part A failed.
label_elsewhere.why: Not applicable for a rejected software paper.

ml_idea: None viable; the paper describes a platform (Galaxy), not a dataset.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check the data availability statement and Zenodo deposit: done, it is software only.
